messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: sustained high RPM detected for model-family xylophone-13b (us-west). 18.2k peak, ~12m sustained. Pager: emma. Severity: P2.

emma: looking. graphs show big spike from a small set of client tokens, short requests. can someone grep logs for org_id and route?

lin: pulling logs now — most traffic pinned to route /v1/generate with streaming enabled. org_id=acme-corp appears in top 3. also seeing many tiny prompts, high fanout.

sam: suggests we apply per-model shaping first, then per-org throttle if needed. on the runtime side we can reduce max concurrent streams for xylophone family.

emma: agreed. immediate mitigations i propose: 1) reduce xylophone-13b RPM from 600 to 200 2) reduce per-model TPM to 10k 3) disable streaming for xylophone-13b for the region 4) enable heavier batching (batch size hint) for that model family.

raj: i can apply the first two quickly via the control plane. confirm sequence: quota change -> disable streaming -> bump batching. any rollback plan?

emma: rollback = revert quotas and re-enable streaming. target window 10m, will monitor latency and 5xx. i'll notify CS.

sam: runbook note: use the sculpt CLI to change model quotas so it propagates to all hosts. example:```
sculpt set-quota --model xylophone-13b --rpm 200 --tpm 10000 --region us-west
```

raj: executing now. /sculpt run in progress...

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: sculpt job 0x7c1f applied: set-quota xylophone-13b rpm=200 tpm=10000 region=us-west. propagation started.

lin: i'm toggling streaming flag on the routing layer:```
PATCH /api/feature-flags
{ model: 'xylophone-13b', flag: 'streaming', value: false, region: 'us-west' }
```

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: feature flag update queued for configservice. change id 5a9. will rollout to nodes in 45s.

tara-cs: heads-up from CS: ACME support pinged about increased truncation and missing streaming chunks. they report degraded UX but no total outage yet. please include them in updates.

emma: pinged tara-cs with mitigation steps and ETA 5m for changes to propagate. also logging customer-impact as "partial degraded for streaming clients" and tagging incident.

lin: post-change metrics: RPM dropped to ~3.2k within 90s, error rate for xylophone fell from 6.2% to 2.1%, end-to-end latency stable. ACME-specific errors reduced but still seeing increased 499s for streaming requests.

sam: looks effective. next step we should consider per-org caps for repeat offenders instead of throttling whole model family long-term. maybe route-level guardrail for /v1/generate.

emma: agree. for now keep quotas and streaming disabled for 30m, then re-evaluate. i'll hand off detailed follow-ups to raj for the night. raj, you're on for the next 4h, please escalate to eng-sre if any regression.

raj: accepted handoff. created follow-up ticket INF-4321 with mitigation steps, logs, and CS notes. tagging eng-sre and runtime. i'll update every 30m or on change.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT_NOTE: INF-4321 created by raj. severity P2. customer impact: ACME partial degraded streaming; ~5% customer request rate affected across all xylophone-13b callers in us-west.

emma: adding runbook excerpt to the ticket with commands and metrics to watch. leaving channel. :hand:

raj: copying planned rollback commands into ticket. if we need to re-open streaming, use:```
sculpt set-quota --model xylophone-13b --rpm 600 --tpm 30000 --region us-west
PATCH /api/feature-flags { model: 'xylophone-13b', flag: 'streaming', value: true }
```

lin: continuing log tail; will post if anything spikes back up.

raj: standing by. if no regressions by +30m we'll start phased re-enable with canary 5% traffic.

pagerduty-bot: MONITOR: Alert cleared for sustained spike. RPM now within expected thresholds.
